claims.statement: All three synthetic strategies are feasible with no constraint violations, and shortfalls are substantial (ranging from 412.01 kg to 606.02 kg), indicating that reported undercoverage is an expected outcome rather than a planning error.
All three strategies report feasible with no constraint violations, but the Lean strategy has the lowest fill_rate at 0.443 and the Resilient strategy has the highest at 0.6213.
All three strategies are feasible with no constraint violations; fill rates below 1.0 are acceptable shortfalls rather than infeasibility, so no strategy should be excluded on fill-rate grounds.
